traits.fruit_type.note: Wikipedia, Prunus (read 2026-10-17): the fruit is a fleshy drupe around one large hard-shelled seed. Stated here so the genus does not take Rosaceae's aggregate fruit.

traits.wood_density_basic_kg_m3.note: GWDD v.2.2 genus aggregate for Prunus (gwddagg_v2.2_genus.csv, read): specific gravity 0.6 (wsg_est, the hierarchical-model genus mean, from 320 records in 70 sources); trunks 0.61, branches 0.6. A species with its own measurements states its own. Basic density is the specific gravity times 1000 kg/m3.

traits.note: Jepson's Manual of the Flowering Plants of California (1925), read in full: calyx 5-cleft; petals spreading; stamens 15 to 30; pistil 1, style terminal (tribe Drupeae, ovary superior).
